thread:
Ravi (People Ops): quick sync 1 launch plan for "Culture Currency" monthly peer kudos. idea: 15 x $25 digital kudos + 30 enamel lapel pins for in-office pickup. want to run pilot next month. need signoff flow, vendor ops, and comms. :money_with_wings:
Nina (People Ops): love the name. timeline idea: open noms for one week, managers get an approval digest, awards cut mid-week, pins handed out at monthly all-hands.
Tom (Eng): timeline works. question: who can nominate? entire company or team-limited?
Ravi (People Ops): open to everyone, but exclude new joiners in first 30 days. we'll enforce with the form.
Sofia (Design): pins 5 mm with two colors? we have a vendor who does quick runs. I'll post mockups in #design-requests.
Liam (Finance): budget check: 15*$25 = $375, pins ~$120 + shipping. use code 4205-people-engage. I can pre-approve up to $700 for pilot. need invoice + receipts.
Aisha (HRBP): we should allow anonymous nominations but require contact for payout. also flag: contractors outside US may need different payout flow.
Ravi (People Ops): noted. we'll add country + contractor toggle on form. for intl, we'll do prepaid e-codes or swag instead.
eng-bot: Nomination form draft created: https://forms.gle/culturepilot 1 nominations open when People Ops flips the toggle.
Nina (People Ops): volunteer ops: I'll run the nomination triage. Ravi can own payouts. Sofia will handle pin art. Tom can help with on-site distribution.
Tom (Eng): happy to help distribution and the one-pager blurb for Eng channels.
Sofia (Design): pin concepts uploaded: https://drive.redwood/pins/concepts. prefer simple mark + "Culture Currency" text.
Ravi (People Ops): comms cadence proposal: announce Mon, open form Tue, close next Mon, managers get approval Tue after close, payouts Wed, pins available at all-hands Fri. anyone opposed?
Liam (Finance): approve cadence. reminder: for any recipient outside US, please tag me early so I can confirm payout method.
Aisha (HRBP): also add an opt-in for recipients to share their kudos on public channels (for shoutouts). privacy first.
Nina (People Ops): operational detail: we'll batch gift card purchases to reduce fees. need manager email field and a checkbox for "manager approves" or autoselect manager email if employee listed.
Ravi (People Ops): good catch. Nina, can you set the form to require manager email only if "manager approves" unchecked?
Nina (People Ops): yep, conditional required field set. demo ready: https://forms.gle/culturepilot (0 responses so far).
Sofia (Design): also proposing a tiny 8.5x11 print sign for the pin table: text "Pick up your Culture Pin & Nominate a teammate". I'll drop layout in #printing.
Tom (Eng): will print if you paste the PDF.
Liam (Finance): vendor note: if pins are >$500, procure via PO. Sofia, what's vendor estimate?
Sofia (Design): vendor quote says $115 for 30 pins + $15 shipping. under $500. ordering tomorrow unless design feedback.
Ravi (People Ops): approvals needed: Aisha for policy ok, Liam for budget ok, and exec sponsor? I'll ping Maya for greenlight.
Aisha (HRBP): policy ok. small ask: include eligibility text in comms (no nominating your direct report? or allowed?). recommend allow cross-level nominations but managers should recuse from self-noms.
Nina (People Ops): will add short eligibility blurb. draft comms: "Culture Currency pilot: nominate a teammate for a $25 kudos or pick up a pin at all-hands. Open to all employees & contractors >30 days. Close date: MM/DD."
Ravi (People Ops): next steps checklist: 1) finalize pin art by EOD, 2) confirm vendor + order by tomorrow noon, 3) open form Tue 9am, 4) close next Mon 5pm, 5) managers review Tues, 6) payout Wed, 7) pins at Fri all-hands.
Liam (Finance): I'll pre-authorize spend and track in GL 4205. send me final invoice by Thursday.
Tom (Eng): volunteers: I'll run pin table Fri 12:30-1:30. Nina, can you handle the manager approval digest on Tue 10am?
Nina (People Ops): yes. I'll compile and ping managers with a short list and a single-click approve link.
Ravi (People Ops): thanks team. if you're volunteering react with :raised_hands: or reply here. using this thread as the canonical plan.
Tom (Eng): :raised_hands: 
Nina (People Ops): :raised_hands: 
Sofia (Design): :raised_hands: 
Liam (Finance): :thumbsup: 
Aisha (HRBP): :thumbsup:
